title: Acquisition
log: 2026-10-29T12:22:32Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

match.reason: No point in the bank covers staff acquisition through workforce planning, recruitment and selection; the closest, resources needed to start, only mentions planning staff in passing before opening a business.

draft.title: Acquisition
card: Acquisition is the part of the human resource process that gets the right staff into a business. It starts by working out how many workers are needed and what skills they must have.
finding and attracting a pool of possible applicants, for example by advertising the job online or promoting from within the business.
choosing the best applicant from that pool, for example by checking applications, interviewing and contacting referees.
A job description lists the duties of a role. A person specification lists the skills and qualities a worker needs. Both guide the advertisement and the choice of applicant.
draft.remember: Acquisition runs in order: work out the need, attract applicants, then choose one.

a.q: Which task is part of selection, rather than recruitment?
opts: Interviewing applicants and checking their referees
Placing a job advertisement on an online job board
Writing a job description for a vacant role
Telling current staff about an internal vacancy
a.why: Selection is choosing the best person from the applicants, and interviews and referee checks do that. Advertising is tempting, but it only attracts applicants, so it belongs to recruitment.
a.clue: Which task happens after the applicants have already come forward?

b.q: Priya owns a bakery in Orange. A baker resigns, so she posts the vacancy on a job website, and 14 people apply. Which step has Priya completed so far?
opts: Recruitment, because she has attracted applicants
Selection, because she has received applications
Recruitment, because she has chosen a new baker
Selection, because she has placed the advertisement
b.why: Posting the vacancy and drawing 14 applicants is recruitment, which builds the pool of possible workers. Selection has not started, because Priya has not yet chosen anyone from that pool.
b.clue: Has Priya chosen anyone yet, or only gathered people to choose from?

a.best: Interviewing applicants and checking their referees

b.best: Recruitment, because she has attracted applicants
